description: This file defines classes and functions for generating CUDA code templates, particularly for GEMM operations, with support for caching, code generation, and integration with CUTLASS. It includes classes for CUDA templates and CUTLASS templates, with methods for rendering code, managing cache, and handling runtime arguments.

classes.name: ArgInfo
classes.description: Data class representing runtime argument information with name and type.

classes.name: CUDATemplate
classes.description: Base class for CUDA code templates, supporting code generation, caching, and kernel rendering.

classes.name: CUTLASSTemplate
classes.description: Derived class for CUTLASS-specific CUDA templates, adding CUTLASS headers, macros, and type casting utilities.

methods.name: make_key
methods.description: Creates a cache key based on input parameters and runtime info to cache generated code.

methods.name: generate_code_and_args
methods.description: Generates CUDA code and runtime argument list, utilizing cache if enabled.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a CUDA template caller object for a specific GEMM operation, supporting autotuning.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns a buffer with necessary header includes for CUDA code.

methods.name: globals
methods.description: Returns a buffer with global macros and namespace setup for CUDA code.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to render CUDA code; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: get_runtime_arg_info
methods.description: Returns list of runtime argument info; default is empty.

methods.name: get_runtime_arg_values
methods.description: Returns list of runtime argument values; default is empty.
